name: NEAR Intents
description: NEAR Intents are a new type of transaction that allow information, requests, assets, and actions to be exchanged between AI agents, services, and end users
methodology: TVL calculated from tokens locked in NEAR Intents Verifier contract across multiple chains

hacks.name: NEAR Intents
hacks.description: NEAR Intents was exploited through a bug in the interaction between its Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure and the NEAR Intents smart contract, allowing unauthorized withdrawals. The team stopped services, patched the contract-side vulnerability, and temporarily suspended deposits and withdrawals across multiple networks while completing fixes to the Omni infrastructure. The stolen funds were traced toward KuCoin and then BTC, and NEAR Intents said the losses would be compensated in full
